sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.nameNick FROM Master T1 JOIN AwardsPlayers T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.award = 'All-Rookie' AND T1.birthMon = '3'
SELECT T1.birthYear FROM Master T1 JOIN AwardsPlayers T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID GROUP BY T1.birthYear ORDER BY COUNT(T2.award) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.birthCountry FROM Master T1 JOIN AwardsPlayers T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID GROUP BY T1.playerID ORDER BY COUNT(T2.award) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT W FROM Goalies WHERE playerID = 'vanbijo01' AND year = 1990
SELECT T2.w FROM AwardsCoaches T1 JOIN Coaches T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.year = 1933 AND T1.award = 'Second Team All-Star'
SELECT T2.birthCountry, T2.birthState, T2.birthCity FROM Coaches T1 JOIN Master T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID WHERE T1.notes = 'co-coach with Dave Lewis' AND T1.year = 1998
SELECT T2.shootCatch FROM Goalies T1 JOIN Master T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.year = 2010 ORDER BY CAST(T1.SHO AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.firstName, T2.lastName FROM Goalies T1 JOIN Master T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.year = 2002 AND CAST(T1.GA AS INTEGER) > 150 ORDER BY CAST(T2.birthYear AS INTEGER) DESC, CAST(T2.birthMon AS INTEGER) DESC, CAST(T2.birthDay AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T2.firstName, T2.lastName FROM Goalies T1 JOIN Master T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.tmID = 'NJD' GROUP BY T1.playerID ORDER BY SUM(T1.SA - T1.GA) DESC LIMIT 1

WITH s AS (SELECT T2.name, SUM(CAST(T1.PostENG AS INTEGER)) AS e FROM Goalies T1 JOIN Teams T2 ON T1.year = T2.year AND T1.tmID = T2.tmID WHERE T1.year = 2010 GROUP BY T1.tmID) SELECT name FROM s WHERE e = (SELECT MAX(e) FROM s)
SELECT GP FROM ScoringSC WHERE playerID = 'broadpu01' AND year = 1922
SELECT G FROM ScoringSC WHERE playerID = 'dyeba01' AND year = 1921
SELECT DISTINCT pos FROM ScoringSC WHERE playerID = 'hartgi01'
SELECT BenchMinor, name FROM Teams ORDER BY T DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CAST(PPG AS REAL) * 100 / PPC FROM Teams ORDER BY L DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(playerID) FROM Master WHERE shootCatch IS NULL AND firstNHL = '2011'
SELECT DISTINCT T2.award, T1.coachID FROM Coaches T1 JOIN AwardsCoaches T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID WHERE T1.coachID = (SELECT coachID FROM Coaches ORDER BY w DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT T2.nameGiven FROM Scoring T1 JOIN Master T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.year BETWEEN 2003 AND 2005 AND T1.PIM BETWEEN 200 AND 250 ORDER BY T1.GP DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.pos, T1.award, T2.nameGiven, T2.lastName FROM AwardsPlayers T1 JOIN Master T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.pos = (SELECT pos FROM AwardsPlayers WHERE pos IS NOT NULL GROUP BY pos ORDER BY COUNT(award) DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY T1.year DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) OVER (), T1.name, O.name FROM Teams T1 JOIN TeamVsTeam T2 ON T1.year = T2.year AND T1.tmID = T2.tmID JOIN Teams O ON T2.oppID = O.tmID AND T2.year = O.year WHERE T1.year = 1915 AND T1.tmID = (SELECT tmID FROM Teams WHERE year = 1915 ORDER BY W DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT T2.rank, T2.year, T2.name FROM Scoring T1 JOIN Teams T2 ON T1.year = T2.year AND T1.tmID = T2.tmID WHERE CAST(T1.SHA AS INTEGER) >= 7 ORDER BY T1.A DESC LIMIT 1
